I searched for the literal `comment.created`, skipping `node_modules` and `.next`, and got 18 files. Three of those I left out because they only contain property access on `comment.createdAt`, not the event name: `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`, `src/components/domain/comment/comment-item.tsx` and `src/components/domain/comment/comment-thread.tsx`. I also checked for the name being built from pieces (for example `"comment." + ...` or a template string) and found none. The config, scripts and manifest files don't contain it.

That leaves 15 files. The event name appears as:
- **Type/union and enum definitions:** `src/types/event.ts` (event map key), `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`, `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`.
- **The emitter:** `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` (in the `emit` call and a doc comment).
- **Subscribers:** the activity, webhook, notification and search services under `src/server/services/`. The activity and webhook services also pass the name on as a value.
- **A doc comment:** `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`.
- **Tests:** four test files under `tests/`. I counted tests as source files; drop them if you only want production code.

ANSWER: src/types/event.ts, src/types/activity.ts, src/schemas/activity.ts, src/schemas/webhook.ts, src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, tests/server/domain-events.test.ts, tests/services/notification-service.test.ts, tests/services/comment-service.test.ts, tests/services/activity-service.test.ts
